# Rotated group lines

Original XML fixture generated by `tools/rotated_line_fixture.py`, with no third-party artwork. The reference application exported the one-page PDF without saving the DOCX. The JSON records the PDF stroke endpoints, translated from bottom-origin page coordinates to the drawing origin (36, 52.97 points). Source and PDF SHA-256 hashes bind this evidence to the fixture. All strokes are 2pt, dash-dot, directed from the first endpoint to the second.

The 22 cases cover flat lines, positive/negative/multiple-turn angles, both reflections, nested and nonuniform group scales, and both sides of the 45/135/225/315-degree scale-axis boundaries. At 45 degrees the reference application rotates dimensions scaled with exchanged parent axes; at 135 degrees it returns to ordinary axes. This differs from applying the ancestor affine matrix after the child's rotation. See docs/conformance.md for the supported subset and specification discussion.
